subject: Post-Campaign Movement Building
overview: Former candidate Anna Callahan delivered a post-campaign update outlining plans to continue political organizing and community engagement following her election loss. She announced upcoming initiatives including door knocking, Zoom meetings, and district walk-and-talks ahead of the November 3 election.

items.title: Post-Campaign Update and Political Organizing Plans
items.summary: Anna Callahan announced plans to continue community engagement and political organizing through door knocking, Zoom meetings, and district walk-and-talks focused on progressive policy goals ahead of the November 3 election.
